title: AUREN Global Factory and Bank Discovery Sources
scope: Global discovery of manufacturers, factories, industrial suppliers, and banks/regulated financial institutions.
critical_notes: Catalog entries are discovery sources only, not live API integrations.
Manufacturer directory listings do not prove that a company owns a factory or is currently operating; verify registration, address, certifications, production capability, and export records.
Bank directory listings do not prove solvency, deposit protection, or suitability for payments. Prefer the relevant official regulator for licensing checks.
No entry should be marked verified until the URL and the intended register/directory are manually checked.
